Consider the functions $y(x) = Ax$ and $f(y) = By$, where $x ∈ R^{3}, y ∈ R^{2}$, and the matrices $A$ and $B$ are given by
$A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 2 & 4 & 6\end{bmatrix}, B = \begin{bmatrix}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 \\ 2 & 3\end{bmatrix}$.
What is $\frac{d}{dx}f(y(x))$ evaluated at $x_{0} = [1, 0, 1]^{T}$?

| $\left.\frac{d}{dx}f(y(x))\right\|_{x_{0}} =$ |  | {{field-1}} | {{field-2}} | {{field-3}} |  |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
|  | $3$ | {{field-4}} | $9$ |  |  |
|  | $8$ | {{field-5}} | $24$ |  |  |
